title: 船用密封與軸承可靠度
summary: 以溫度、摩擦、振動與入水跡象建立密封軸承的多證據診斷。 在軸封與軸承狀態資料室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Use temperature, friction, vibration and ingress evidence for seal/bearing diagnosis. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Seal/bearing condition-data laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 面壓速度與摩擦熱：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pressure-speed and friction heat: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 面壓速度與摩擦熱 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pressure-speed and friction heat and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船用密封與軸承可靠度」的「面壓速度與摩擦熱」中，PV 值結合面壓和滑動速度，用於比較摩擦熱負荷尺度。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：以溫度、摩擦、振動與入水跡象建立密封軸承的多證據診斷。
steps.instructionEn: Within Marine seal and bearing reliability, Pressure-speed and friction heat examines this mechanism: PV combines contact pressure and sliding speed as a frictional heat-load scale. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Use temperature, friction, vibration and ingress evidence for seal/bearing diagnosis.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：F=1000 N，A=0.002 m²，v=2 m/s。關係式 PV=(F/A)v；含單位換算算式 1000/0.002/1e6*2 = 1 MPa·m/s。適用條件：比較指標而非材料允許值；潤滑、散熱和偏載不可省略。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Load 1000 N, area 0.002 m² and sliding speed 2 m/s. Relation PV=(F/A)v; expression including unit conversion 1000/0.002/1e6*2 = 1 MPa·m/s. Applicability: Comparison metric, not a material limit; lubrication, cooling and edge load matter.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：平均面壓正常仍可能存在邊緣接觸高壓。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Normal mean pressure can coexist with high edge contact pressure. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「面壓速度與摩擦熱」，同時看溫度趨勢與振動，區分負荷增加和潤滑惡化。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Pressure-speed and friction heat, Use temperature trends and vibration to distinguish loading from lubrication loss. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
